name: Metorial

modes.label: Native service
modes.note: Hardware and complete resource tariff unverified.

caveats: Free 500k tool calls/month, Scale $250/month includes 2.5M calls and 20 seats, then $20/seat; extra calls $1/1500, callbacks $1/750. Does not guarantee arbitrary-code CPU/RAM hours; fair-use applies even to unlimited sessions. EU/US hosted, open-source self-hosting and enterprise on-prem.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

fleet.tiers: Dev: one environment, hobby limits, no production access; Scale and Enterprise provide higher service allowances.
fleet.notes: Tool calls, integrations and Workforce seats are not VM counts. No published per-account fresh running-machine/vCPU/GPU quota found; enterprise customization not an automatic fleet entitlement.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: Managed providers let you deploy custom MCP server code without managing infrastructure. Upload your code and Metorial handles hosting, scaling, and deployment.
snapshot_auto.note: Not a sandbox/VM product: the only user code Metorial runs is custom MCP servers on a managed Node.js runtime (serverless-style, open-source function-bay). No machine state to checkpoint.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: A custom provider version is a versioned snapshot of your custom integration.
snapshot_on_demand.note: 'Snapshot' here means an immutable code version (with instant rollback), not a machine/filesystem snapshot.

harness_api.quote: Metorial connects AI agents and MCP clients to the apps your team already uses, with access controls and activity logs.
harness_api.note: Metorial is an MCP integration gateway used BY agents (sessions, tool calls, Workforce/portals, Magic Skills); it does not run or drive an agent harness inside a sandbox.

secret_proxy.quote: Auth configs are stored per user. If 100 users connect their Slack accounts, you have 100 auth configs. This keeps credentials isolated and auditable.
secret_proxy.note: Metorial stores OAuth tokens/API keys (auth configs, config vaults) and uses them server-side when executing MCP tool calls, so the calling agent never sees them; but it is a tool gateway, not a proxy that injects credentials into arbitrary outbound HTTP from a sandbox. Custom provider code receives its config values. Provider auth exports can extract tokens.

volume_attach.quote: Beyond the pre-built integrations in the Metorial catalog, you can upload your own MCP server code and let Metorial host it. Metorial handles scaling and monitoring.
volume_attach.note: No storage/volume product documented for hosted providers.

volume_shared.note: No volumes of any kind documented.
